node.statement: Let C_* := max{C_nest,1} and e_ncd := min{e_nest,(2C_*)^{-1}}, where C_nest,e_nest are supplied by lem-maincb-nested-corner-comparison. Then e_ncd>0 is universal; under the hypotheses of node 1 the cited lemma applies, and with U:=S^A_{P,Q}, V:=S^{A_R}_{P^R,Q^R}, T:=Co^A_R|_U:U→V, and S:=Co^A_{P,Q}|_V:V→U it gives ||F^R_{P,Q}(TX)-X||≤C_*t||X|| for X∈U and ||SY-Y||≤C_*t||Y|| for Y∈V, with C_*t≤1/2.
